row.title: DEPTH-1 depth bar for self-chosen apps
row.body: Rowan 2026-11-22: self-chosen apps must carry thesis, growing corpus, loop, hook, reason to return, public good and a 3-phase horizon; lookups, boards, templates and commerce never launch. Retired 8 shallow spinoffs; seeded base-rates, did-it-work, open-questions for the seed pipeline.
